thesis: Hold, no positions and no new orders this hour. The 15:00 ET pack is almost entirely non-actionable for a conservative ETF-sleeve book: dozens of routine 8-Ks (ABS trust filings, officer departures, routine FD disclosures), several MarketWatch personal-finance advice columns, and politician PTR disclosures dated 9/15-9/22 that are stale relative to this hour and carry no security-level trade detail. The two items with market color are non-catalytic for broad sleeves: the US-China note explicitly says tariff relief is narrow (dolls/fireworks) with 'no major breakthroughs' and rare earths still stuck, and the Micron/Nvidia pieces are forward-looking analyst commentary ahead of an earnings report that hasn't happened, not dated fundamental news. MongoDB's single-name CEO-departure selloff is outside a conservative core-ETF/satellite mandate. Per the conservative brief (25% cash floor, 25% max name, 4-position cap, capital preservation over headline-chasing) and this being a propose-only hourly consensus step, I'm not proposing new exposure on a thin, ambiguous pack. Will revisit if a subsequent hour's pack contains a dated, decision-relevant macro or ETF-level catalyst.
